name: Goodly Knight
summary: A formation fighter whose Knight's Oath grants STR to adjacent allies while Oracle reshapes attributes after every battle.
quote: Takes the worst place in the line and calls it an oath.

trait.name: Oracle
trait.effect: -2 STR, +1 AGI, +2 INT after each battle.

tactic.name: Formation
tactic.effect: Stays in formation and can reduce damage taken.

name: Portly Knight
summary: A durable formation unit whose Hoarding trait rewards keeping equipped gear on the board.
quote: Will hold the line to the end.

trait.name: Hoarding
trait.effect: +4G income with Trinket, one-handed, two-handed, Shield, or Spell gear on board.

skills.name: Rotund
skills.effect: Gains ATK equal to 15% of starting HP and has -10% SPD.

tactic.name: Formation
tactic.effect: Stays in formation and can reduce damage taken.

name: Archer
summary: A backline ranged unit that grows STR and AGI through the Versatile trait.
quote: Hunted elk for the knights. Soldiers are slower.

trait.name: Versatile
trait.effect: -1 ALL once, then +1 STR and +1 AGI after each battle.

tactic.name: Backline
tactic.effect: Prefers to stay in the backline.

name: Wizard
summary: An INT-led backline caster with strong Energy Shield and increased spell damage.
quote: Carries three books from a college that denies knowing him.

skills.name: Quick-Witted
skills.effect: +2 ES per 1 AGI; -1 STR to adjacent allies.

tactic.name: Backline
tactic.effect: Prefers to stay in the backline.

name: Skeleton Child
summary: A flanking support unit that passes half of hand-gear benefits to adjacent allies and can respawn once.
quote: Buried with a toy sword. Came back with a real one.

trait.name: Magnanimous
trait.effect: Receives no hand-gear benefits; adjacent allies receive 50% of those benefits instead.

skills.name: Respawn
skills.effect: Returns once per battle at a back corner.

tactic.name: Flanking
tactic.effect: Can enter combat from behind enemy lines.

name: Skeleton Dog
summary: A fast flanker that grows stronger whenever an ally dies.
quote: Fed on battlefield scraps since the first rising.

skills.name: Feast
skills.effect: When an ally dies, gain +1 ATK and +2 HP.

tactic.name: Flanking
tactic.effect: Can enter combat from behind enemy lines.
